title: Roberta isn't eager to become famous (again)

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: Hey, I need to talk to you. It's about this photography series that Elaine Malloy wants to make about me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I need to talk to you. It's about this photography series that Elaine Malloy wants to make about me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm really not interested in it Roberta.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm really not interested in it Roberta.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm really not interested in it Roberta.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm really not interested in it Roberta.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: So this Elaine Malloy is talented and she seems very clever and all...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So this Elaine Malloy is talented and she seems very clever and all...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But?

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: She said you had given permission for her to shoot me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She said you had given permission for her to shoot me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She asked to shoot in the restaurant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She asked to shoot in the restaurant.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She asked to shoot in the restaurant.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She asked to shoot in the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I don't want to do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want to do it.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: So... do you want to know why I refused?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... do you want to know why I refused?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, if you want to tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, if you want to tell me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure, if you want to tell me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure, if you want to tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not really. You don't want to. That's all I need to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really. You don't want to. That's all I need to know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not really. You don't want to. That's all I need to know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not really. You don't want to. That's all I need to know.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: So it's nothing too scandalous. I just... need to keep a low profile. You see, I'm not from around here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it's nothing too scandalous. I just... need to keep a low profile. You see, I'm not from around here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not from Nivalis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not from Nivalis?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not from this district?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not from this district?

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I'm from the Eastern Peninsula. I came here with a Sand Turtle desert transport HOVA.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm from the Eastern Peninsula. I came here with a Sand Turtle desert transport HOVA.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're from outside the city?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're from outside the city?

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I wasn't safe back home. My father was a retired Corpster with company secrets in his head that he couldn't get rid of. He just wanted a peaceful life for his family out in the protein farms, but the Corps sent a bounty hunter after him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wasn't safe back home. My father was a retired Corpster with company secrets in his head that he couldn't get rid of. He just wanted a peaceful life for his family out in the protein farms, but the Corps sent a bounty hunter after him.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: Yes, and they'll never stop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, and they'll never stop.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: It doesn't matter that I don't know any of his corporate secrets. It doesn't matter that I'm just a waitress. I'm a loose end, and the Corp's pay a premium on cutting the loose ends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It doesn't matter that I don't know any of his corporate secrets. It doesn't matter that I'm just a waitress. I'm a loose end, and the Corp's pay a premium on cutting the loose ends.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So will the bounty hunter find you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So will the bounty hunter find you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So will the bounty hunter find you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So will the bounty hunter find you?

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I don't think so. Not unless I advertise myself all across the city by... I dunno, appearing in a world-famous ad campaign.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think so. Not unless I advertise myself all across the city by... I dunno, appearing in a world-famous ad campaign.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will this bounty hunter come here and cause trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will this bounty hunter come here and cause trouble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will this bounty hunter come here and cause trouble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will this bounty hunter come here and cause trouble?

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: No. I changed my name, my face, left my friends and family behind. Only doing something monumentally stupid like becoming a famous model could put me at risk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I changed my name, my face, left my friends and family behind. Only doing something monumentally stupid like becoming a famous model could put me at risk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll try to keep you safe here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll try to keep you safe here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll try to keep you safe here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll try to keep you safe here.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: As long as I keep my head down, the bounty hunters will NEVER find me. I've played it safe for a long time. It's not the time to take crazy risks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As long as I keep my head down, the bounty hunters will NEVER find me. I've played it safe for a long time. It's not the time to take crazy risks.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I worked hard to start a new life here. I sacrificed everything, but I knew what I had to do, and I got my head down and I did it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I worked hard to start a new life here. I sacrificed everything, but I knew what I had to do, and I got my head down and I did it.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I'm sorry to turn you down. This new job has been a great stepping stone in building my life back up. But I can't be in the public eye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry to turn you down. This new job has been a great stepping stone in building my life back up. But I can't be in the public eye.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I completely understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I completely understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm disappointed you won't take a risk to help my business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm disappointed you won't take a risk to help my business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm disappointed you won't take a risk to help my business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm disappointed you won't take a risk to help my business.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I know having someone like me on your staff might seem like a risk, but everyone has baggage. Everyone has a history. I can promise you, my past problems will never interfere with work or put you at risk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know having someone like me on your staff might seem like a risk, but everyone has baggage. Everyone has a history. I can promise you, my past problems will never interfere with work or put you at risk.

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: I would hate you to think I'm not cooperative or thinking about the reputation of the restaurant. But I'm relieved I don't need to do this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would hate you to think I'm not cooperative or thinking about the reputation of the restaurant. But I'm relieved I don't need to do this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did they find you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did they find you?

nodes.speaker: Roberta Fringle
nodes.text: They always find you. I hid under a harvester bot while they dragged my father into a prisoner transport. He told them I was with my mother. I never even had a mother...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They always find you. I hid under a harvester bot while they dragged my father into a prisoner transport. He told them I was with my mother. I never even had a mother...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's your choice to be photographed or not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's your choice to be photographed or not.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's your choice to be photographed or not.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's your choice to be photographed or not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You ran from your home?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You ran from your home?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are they still looking for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are they still looking for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are they still looking for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are they still looking for you?
